fingerprint-hardware-concurrency.description: Allowed CPU core counts per persona platform; values are not the host core count.

window-size.description: WIDTH,HEIGHT window size passed to the kernel; window size only, never a screen resolution.

disable-spoofing.description: Spoof categories supported by this artifact for every persona platform; any other category must be rejected.

limitations: Host-bound screen size, devicePixelRatio, color depth and font enumeration remain observable.
Headless pseudo_headful mode changes UA only; other Headless characteristics remain.

Canvas sub-region readback can differ from full-surface readback (#98); WebGL readPixels can differ between 1x1 and 8x8 reads (#99); probe reports must attribute both gaps to the kernel, not to the spec.
